label: Points/Game
description: Average points scored per game.

label: Points Allowed/Game
description: Average points allowed per game.

label: Scoring Margin
description: Points scored minus points allowed, per game.

label: Yards/Play (Off)
description: Offensive yards per scrimmage play.

label: Yards/Play (Def)
description: Yards allowed per opponent scrimmage play.

label: Net Yards/Play
description: Offensive yards per play minus defensive yards per play allowed.

label: Rush Yds/Game
description: Rushing yards per game.

label: Opp Rush Yds/Game
description: Rushing yards allowed per game.

label: Yards/Rush
description: Rushing yards per rushing attempt.

label: Opp Yards/Rush
description: Rushing yards allowed per opponent attempt.

label: Pass Yds/Game
description: Net passing yards per game.

label: Opp Pass Yds/Game
description: Net passing yards allowed per game.

label: Yards/Pass Att
description: Net passing yards per pass attempt.

label: Opp Yards/Pass Att
description: Net passing yards allowed per opponent attempt.

label: Completion %
description: Completions divided by attempts.

label: Sack Rate Allowed
description: Sacks taken per dropback.

label: Sack Rate
description: Sacks generated per opponent dropback.

label: Pressure Rate Allowed
description: Opponent pressures per dropback (PFR).

label: Pressure Rate
description: Individual defender pressures per opponent dropback (PFR); can exceed play-level rate.

label: Havoc Allowed
description: Share of offensive plays with a TFL, sack, forced fumble, interception or pass breakup against.

label: Havoc Rate
description: Share of defensive plays producing a TFL, sack, forced fumble, interception or pass breakup.

label: Front-Seven Havoc
description: Havoc plays generated by the front seven, per defensive play.

label: Secondary Havoc
description: Havoc plays generated by defensive backs, per defensive play.

label: Line Yards
description: Rushing yards credited to the offensive line per rush (Football Outsiders formula).

label: Line Yards Allowed
description: Line yards allowed per opponent rush.

label: Opportunity Rate
description: Share of rushes gaining at least 4 yards.

label: Stuff Rate Allowed
description: Share of rushes stopped at or behind the line.

label: Stuff Rate
description: Share of opponent rushes stopped at or behind the line.

label: Power Success
description: Conversion rate on 3rd/4th down rushes needing 2 yards or fewer.

label: 3rd Down % (Off)
description: Third-down conversion rate.

label: 3rd Down % (Def)
description: Third-down conversion rate allowed.

label: 4th Down % (Off)
description: Fourth-down conversion rate.

label: Red Zone TD % (Off)
description: Touchdowns per red-zone trip.

label: Red Zone TD % (Def)
description: Touchdowns allowed per opponent red-zone trip.

label: Turnover Margin
description: Takeaways minus giveaways, per game.

label: Giveaways/Game
description: Turnovers committed per game.

label: Takeaways/Game
description: Turnovers forced per game.

label: INT Rate
description: Interceptions thrown per pass attempt.

label: Fumble Rate
description: Fumbles lost per offensive play.

label: Offensive EPA/Play
description: Expected points added per play (CFB: CFBD PPA; NFL: nflfastR EPA).

label: Offensive Passing EPA/Play
description: EPA per pass play.

label: Offensive Rushing EPA/Play
description: Expected points added per rushing play.

label: Offensive Early-Down EPA
description: EPA per play on 1st and 2nd down.

label: Offensive Late-Down EPA
description: EPA per play on 3rd and 4th down.

label: Offensive Success Rate
description: Share of plays meeting the success yardage threshold (NFL: EPA>0).

label: Offensive Passing Success
description: Success rate on pass plays.

label: Offensive Rushing Success
description: Success rate on rushes.

label: Offensive Standard-Down Success
description: Success rate on standard downs.

label: Offensive Passing-Down Success
description: Success rate on passing downs.

label: Offensive Explosiveness
description: Average EPA on successful plays (IsoPPP-style).

label: Defensive EPA/Play
description: Expected points added per play allowed (CFB: CFBD PPA; NFL: nflfastR EPA).

label: Defensive Passing EPA/Play
description: EPA per pass play allowed.

label: Defensive Rushing EPA/Play
description: Expected points added per rushing play allowed.

label: Defensive Early-Down EPA
description: EPA per play on 1st and 2nd down allowed.

label: Defensive Late-Down EPA
description: EPA per play on 3rd and 4th down allowed.

label: Defensive Success Rate
description: Share of plays allowed meeting the success yardage threshold (NFL: EPA>0).

label: Defensive Passing Success
description: Success rate on pass plays allowed.

label: Defensive Rushing Success
description: Success rate on rushes allowed.

label: Defensive Standard-Down Success
description: Success rate on standard downs allowed.

label: Defensive Passing-Down Success
description: Success rate on passing downs allowed.

label: Defensive Explosiveness
description: Average EPA on successful plays allowed (IsoPPP-style).

label: Explosive Play Rate
description: Share of plays gaining 10+ rushing or 20+ passing yards.

label: Explosive Plays Allowed
description: Share of opponent plays gaining 10+ rushing or 20+ passing yards.

label: 10+ Yard Rush Rate
description: Share of rushes gaining 10+ yards.

label: 20+ Yard Pass Rate
description: Share of dropbacks producing a 20+ yard completion.

label: Points/Scoring Opportunity
description: Points per drive that reached the opponent 40.

label: Points Allowed/Scoring Opp
description: Points allowed per opponent drive reaching your 40.

label: TD Rate in Opp Territory
description: Touchdowns per drive that reached the opponent 40.

label: Avg Starting Field Position
description: Average own-yardline where offensive drives start.

label: Opp Avg Starting Field Position
description: Average own-yardline where opponent drives start.

label: Plays/Game
description: Offensive scrimmage plays per game.

label: Seconds/Play
description: Average seconds between offensive snaps within a drive.

label: Neutral-Script Seconds/Play
description: Seconds per play when the score is within 8 in the first three quarters.

label: Pass Rate
description: Dropbacks per scrimmage play.

label: Early-Down Pass Rate
description: Dropbacks per play on 1st and 2nd down.

label: Neutral-Script Pass Rate
description: Dropbacks per play when the game is within 8 points in the first three quarters.

label: Play-Action Rate
description: Play-action dropbacks per dropback (FTN).

label: RPO Rate
description: RPO plays per scrimmage play (FTN).

label: Shotgun Rate
description: Snaps from shotgun per scrimmage play.

label: Avg Air Yards
description: Average depth of target on pass attempts.

label: Deep Pass Rate
description: Share of attempts thrown 20+ yards downfield.

label: Blitz Rate
description: Share of opponent dropbacks with 5+ pass rushers (FTN).

label: Pressure Without Blitz
description: QB hits or sacks per opponent dropback with 4 or fewer rushers (proxy).
